Execution boundary: planning approved; this issue does not authorize commits, pushes, merges, upstream publication, GitHub comments, live WhatsApp access, or real messages. Revalidate current source/Git state before implementation. Preserve unrelated work, including the already-edited docs/architecture.md. Track this work in the ZAQ Beadwork store even when files belong to the sibling package; do not initialize another store.
Read AGENTS.md in the affected repository. For ZAQ read docs/agent-tools.md, docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/testing-approach.md, docs/conventions.md and docs/code-quality.md plus the domain policies listed below. Read module documentation before editing. Source navigation uses Serena with bounded fallback if unavailable. Record test results honestly; plan approval is not completed-feature UX approval. Follow repository validation owners; no assertion weakening or unrelated refactors. Existing test changes outside the specifically approved contracts need human approval.

Required domain policies: docs/documentation.md; docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md validation lifecycle; docs/e2e-testing.md for existing E2E execution.

Functional specifications covered with associated files to edit/add:
Review the complete final diff for points 2–5 in both repositories. Verify no changes to jido_chat or Amarula, no concrete WhatsApp storage calls from ZAQ, no new agent/tool exposure, normalized phone/name flow, super-admin enable restrictions, and cleanup exclusion/failure ordering. Ensure the final installed package SHA has required changes and all relevant paths use shared operations.
Preserve and review the local docs/architecture.md point-6 correction; it is already edited, not a fresh implementation task. Point 1 PR description was updated previously with reuse assessment; prepare an accurate follow-up text replacing pending wording only when actual code is complete. Updating GitHub requires separately authorized action; do not post comments/resolve threads/request review automatically.
Update authoritative docs/services/channels.md, engine.md and system-config.md and package docs for actual contracts; fix obsolete 'missing listener prevents disable' and local-path dependency statements. Do not expand issue #22 product scope or claim its separate acceptance clarification resolved.
Collect focused package/ZAQ results and existing E2E execution evidence; record exact revisions and any failures. Prepare a concrete UX review checklist for reused zaq-0l7.7. Existing-test approvals remain narrowly those in zaq-e5z.1 and zaq-e5z.8; retain other assertions.

Tests to add before implementation:
Rerun only affected integrated suites justified by cross-repository changes; verify real dispatch -> storage callbacks and no missing-listener activation regression. Existing E2E execution per workflow; no new E2E authoring until reused UX gate. Check doc links and diff hygiene. Do not claim tests green from historical PR body.

Branches/paths validated:
Complete pairing/name/phone persistence, failed-start disable/archive, super-admin enable/relink, cross-account isolation, polling consumers, package pin and unrelated-adapter compatibility.

Mocking plan:
Real internal boundaries; offline WhatsApp network and external model edge as needed. No live device/account/message without explicit authorization.

Documentations to update for both code and docs/ related content:
Owner documentation and issue validation evidence; prepare review-response/PR-body draft in issue, not an unauthorized external post. Preserve point-6 local edit and approved point-1 assessment.

Action reuse assessment:
Action reuse: not applicable to audit/documentation itself; verify assessments in implementation issues, especially new enable Action prerequisite, package extension choice, canonical Connect persistence and local timer reuse. Do not implement hidden new operations while integrating.
